format: glTF 2.0 binary, Y-up, metres, feet at y=0, character faces +Z, no Draco
animations_note: Clips are stored once in people_anims.glb (armature only). Bone names are identical in every character file and rest rotations are identical; only joint positions differ with proportions. Tracks: rotation on 26 deform bones, translation on root only. Play with an AnimationMixer on the character scene (tracks bind by node name). Scale root.position tracks by root_motion_scale of the character.

clip_notes.walk: foot-locked ground speed measured on the reference character (1.8 m): about 1.04 m/s at timeScale 1 (cycle 1.067 s, step about 0.55 m). The legs cannot reach a 1.4 m/s stride at this cycle length; for faster movement raise timeScale (about speed / 1.04) and accept some blur, or blend into run
clip_notes.run: ankle-path estimate about 2.7 m/s on the reference character at timeScale 1 (cycle 0.7 s)
clip_notes.sit: pose loop; root.position drops by about 0.4 m on the reference character (scale by root_motion_scale)

material: one material per character (people_mat): baseColor from COLOR_0 vertex colours (linear), roughness 0.78, metallic 0; no textures, no UVs
